viewer_result: Desktop and mobile initial views show both fronts and the recessed southeast corner. Both entrance axes, returns and the rhythm of the central recessed bays remain visible. Default front and earlier initial viewpoint concentrate on the south front; east front appears more darkly lit than the south. From above the four pavilions, surrounding roof and rectangular glazed field remain distinct.
form_limits: Upper column capitals, pediments and infill ornament are simplified. Flags, contemporary signage and interiors are omitted. Back window pattern, roof dimensions and glazing bars are estimates.
